name: learn-video
description: Give an agent video evidence: timestamped frames and native captions, with optional local WhisperX or Groq/OpenAI transcription.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent a video input — paste a URL or local path and ask about it.
interface.longDescription: Learn Video gives an agent timestamped frames and a transcript for summaries, visual breakdowns, and questions about a video. Adapted from bradautomates/claude-video under MIT.
defaultPrompt: /learn-video https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
